description: This file defines a Perl module 'Git' providing an interface to the Git version control system. It includes constructors for repository objects, methods to execute various git commands, retrieve repository info, handle configuration, manage credentials, and manipulate repository objects and artifacts. The code also contains error handling classes and utility functions related to git operations.

classes.name: Git::Error::Command
classes.description: Exception class representing errors from executing external git commands, encapsulating the command line, exit status, and output.

methods.name: repository
methods.description: Constructs a new Git repository object, determining repository and working copy paths based on provided options or the current directory.

methods.name: command
methods.description: Executes a git command with optional arguments, returning output as a string or array depending on context.

methods.name: command_oneline
methods.description: Runs a git command and returns only the first line of its output.

methods.name: command_output_pipe
methods.description: Runs a git command and returns a pipe handle to read its output.

methods.name: command_input_pipe
methods.description: Runs a git command and returns a pipe handle to send input to it.

methods.name: command_close_pipe
methods.description: Closes a pipe returned by command_output_pipe or command_input_pipe, checking for command success.

methods.name: command_bidi_pipe
methods.description: Establishes a bidirectional pipe to a git command, returning input/output handles and process ID.

methods.name: command_close_bidi_pipe
methods.description: Closes the bidirectional pipe handles and waits for the command to finish, throwing on error.

methods.name: version
methods.description: Returns the version of Git in use.

methods.name: exec_path
methods.description: Returns the path to git executables.

methods.name: html_path
methods.description: Returns the path to git html documentation.

methods.name: get_tz_offset
methods.description: Calculates timezone offset from GMT in +/-HHMM format for a given time.

methods.name: get_record
methods.description: Reads a record from a filehandle delimited by a specified separator.

methods.name: prompt
methods.description: Prompts the user for input, honoring environment variables for passphrases.

methods.name: repo_path
methods.description: Returns the repository path of a repository object.

methods.name: wc_path
methods.description: Returns the working copy path of a repository object.

methods.name: wc_subdir
methods.description: Returns the subdirectory inside a working copy.

methods.name: wc_chdir
methods.description: Changes the working copy subdirectory for a repository object.

methods.name: config
methods.description: Retrieves configuration variables from git.

methods.name: config_bool
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean configuration variable.

methods.name: config_path
methods.description: Retrieves a path configuration variable.

methods.name: config_int
methods.description: Retrieves an integer configuration variable.

methods.name: config_regexp
methods.description: Retrieves configuration keys matching a regex.

methods.name: get_colorbool
methods.description: Determines if color should be used for an operation based on configuration.

methods.name: get_color
methods.description: Retrieves color settings from configuration.

methods.name: remote_refs
methods.description: Returns refs from a remote repository as a hash.

methods.name: ident
methods.description: Retrieves and parses ident info (author or committer).

methods.name: ident_person
methods.description: Returns name and email string from ident info.

methods.name: hash_object
methods.description: Calculates the SHA1 of a file considering its object type.

methods.name: hash_and_insert_object
methods.description: Calculates and stores the object in the database, returning its SHA1.

methods.name: cat_blob
methods.description: Outputs the content of a blob to a filehandle.

methods.name: port_num
methods.description: Returns a numeric port number or service name.

methods.name: credential_read
methods.description: Reads credential key-value pairs from a filehandle.

methods.name: credential_write
methods.description: Writes credential data to a filehandle.

methods.name: credential
methods.description: Runs the git credential helper with specified operation or code.

methods.name: temp_acquire
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a locked temporary file by name.

methods.name: temp_is_locked
methods.description: Checks if a temp file name is locked.

methods.name: temp_release
methods.description: Releases a lock on a temporary file, optionally truncating.

methods.name: temp_reset
methods.description: Truncates and resets the position of a temp file.

methods.name: temp_path
methods.description: Returns filename of a temp file or handle.

methods.name: unquote_path
methods.description: Decodes a quoted c-escape path string.

methods.name: get_comment_line_char
methods.description: Retrieves the comment character from config.

methods.name: comment_lines
methods.description: Prefixes lines with the comment character from config.
